source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Compare this data to the permitted levels.
3. Document the exceedances.
4. Investigate the cause and document the investigation process.
5. State whether the exceedance required notification to authorities, and confirm it was done.
6. Detail corrective actions taken or planned.
7. Provide clear charts and graphs.
8. Include full source data: monitoring records, permits, etc., as appendices.
9. Proofread with an auditor.
10. Specify units of measurement.

These instructions will help you create a documentation of accurate industrial emissions in an air-quality report. Do you have any confusions or would like me to provide more details on some aspect of the process?
<end_of_turn>
